report.explanation: All admitted evidence is healthy: checkout trace OK at 72ms, error_rate 0.0012, p95 71ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, and INFO/200 logs for order and payment. No observation supports any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). Current facts are insufficient to establish a bounded root cause, so hand off for the alert's triggering signal.
missing_evidence: Traces or metrics showing elevated latency/errors on checkout or any downstream service during the alert window
Per-service error-rate and p95 breakdown distinguishing gateway, order, payment, inventory
Logs at WARN/ERROR level or failing request results for the alert window
Alert definition and threshold that triggered the checkout health alert
